       oListedSecurity."XCL_0225" AS oListedSecurity_hasTickerSymbol,
       oListedSecurity."XCL_0226" AS oListedSecurity_hasLegalName,
       oSecuritiesTransaction."XCL_0328" AS oSecuritiesTransaction_hasType,
       oSecuritiesTransaction."XCL_0329" AS oSecuritiesTransaction_hasSettlementDate,
       oSecuritiesTransaction."XCL_0330" AS oSecuritiesTransaction_hasCount
FROM "XTB_130" AS oSecuritiesTransaction
INNER JOIN "XTB_087" AS oListedSecurity ON oSecuritiesTransaction."XCL_0327" = oListedSecurity."XCL_0222"
INNER JOIN "XTB_058" AS FinancialServiceAccount1 ON oSecuritiesTransaction."XCL_0325" = FinancialServiceAccount1."XCL_0153"
INNER JOIN "XTB_108" AS oPerson ON FinancialServiceAccount1."XCL_0154" = oPerson."XCL_0268"
WHERE oSecuritiesTransaction."XCL_0328" = '1'
  AND oSecuritiesTransaction."XCL_0329" >= '2017-01-01'
  AND oSecuritiesTransaction."XCL_0329" <= '2017-12-31'
  AND oListedSecurity."XCL_0226" IN (
    SELECT oInnerListedSecurity."XCL_0226"
    FROM "XTB_130" AS oInnerSecuritiesTransaction
    INNER JOIN "XTB_087" AS oInnerListedSecurity ON oInnerSecuritiesTransaction."XCL_0327" = oInnerListedSecurity."XCL_0222"
    INNER JOIN "XTB_058" AS innerFinancialServiceAccount1 ON oInnerSecuritiesTransaction."XCL_0325" = innerFinancialServiceAccount1."XCL_0153"
    INNER JOIN "XTB_108" AS oInnerPerson ON innerFinancialServiceAccount1."XCL_0154" = oInnerPerson."XCL_0268"
    WHERE oInnerSecuritiesTransaction."XCL_0328" = '2'
      AND oInnerPerson."XCL_0273" = 'Koji Lucas'
      AND oInnerSecuritiesTransaction."XCL_0329" >= '2016-01-01'
      AND oInnerSecuritiesTransaction."XCL_0329" <= '2016-12-31'
  )
